task_title: QA filing: CF-053 isolation criterion false in the live fleet and uncatchable by the shipped scan; CF-123 probe discriminator is path-sensitive
task_criteria: Scope: THE FILING, not the fix. Do NOT require or evaluate any change to lane config, lane_target.py, tests/selftest.sh or CF-123's probe. Verify only, from the committed tree: (1) the commit's stat is docs-only and adds docs/audits/code-factory-qa-duckbrain-2026-11-04.md; the board rows CF-148 and CF-149 are present in HEAD's .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl (landed by an earlier sibling commit) each with a non-empty single-line probe; (2) CF-053 reads status in_progress in HEAD's board with a foreman_note naming unmet acceptance criterion 4; (3) running CF-148's probe field from the repo root prints "bad": 0, "ok": true and scan_rc=0 for two lanes sharing one workdir; (4) running CF-149's probe prints two arms with unique_red_rows=1 and two 'disk_floor — resolver missing or unreadable:' lines at different temp paths; (5) bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS and bash scripts/boardctl validate prints RESULT: OK at this tree.
